aai-docs-content.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file; it is reused only when no tracked or untracked file changed (admission: reads=1536, nothing to poison). Runs docs-audit and copies docs/ over fixtures; no network, no clock.

aai-spec-lint.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file; it is reused only when no tracked or untracked file changed (admission: reads=1482, nothing to poison). Lints specs in fixtures and in the live docs; no network, no clock.

aai-hygiene-pack.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file; it is reused only when no tracked or untracked file changed (admission: reads=1950, nothing to poison). Runs the hygiene lints and ratchets over the whole tree (the longest of the six); no network, no clock.

aai-prompt-diet.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file; it is reused only when no tracked or untracked file changed (admission: reads=1932, nothing to poison). Counts bytes of every .aai prompt against the ledger; no network, no clock.

aai-ride-status.note: Reads about 27 files by the access trace (admission: reads=27, poisoned=1923): .aai ride-status scripts and prompts, four test files and docs/ai/docs-audit.yaml; it does not read the git index, EVENTS.jsonl, STATE.yaml or test-runs.jsonl, so ledger churn and unrelated edits leave it reused. No network, no clock.

aai-win-fallback.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file; it is reused only when no tracked or untracked file changed (admission: reads=1928, nothing to poison). Exercises the Windows fallback paths with stubs; no network, no clock.

aai-feedback-status.note: Counts fixture friction spools and pending drafts under a mktemp directory through AAI_FRICTION_DIR, with a mock gh (AAI_GH_BIN) that only records its arguments. Admission: reads=4, poisoned=1946. The clock and the network are not read (gh is mocked).

aai-pricing.note: Reads .aai/system/PRICING.yaml and docs/ai/METRICS.jsonl and runs node over them. Admission: reads=4, poisoned=1946. No network, no process table.

aai-redact.note: Pure string-in string-out checks of .aai/scripts/lib/aai-redact.mjs; URL fixtures that must be redacted are never fetched. Admission: reads=2, poisoned=1948.

aai-orchestration-mode.note: Runs orchestration-mode.mjs over fixtures and asserts wiring text in the prompts, USER_GUIDE.md, the STATE header and CHANGELOG.md. Admission: reads=9, poisoned=1941. CHANGELOG.md stays listed as an extra input. No network.

aai-runtime-file.note: Exercises the claim, reclaim and release functions of .aai/scripts/lib/runtime-file.mjs on temp files with child node processes it starts and ends itself. Admission: reads=2, poisoned=1948. No network.
